title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 062
review_goal: Differentiate gift and git branch families with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Square gift box with a centered ribbon cross and one bow above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a squarer wrapped present with the ribbon cross centered on the front.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the taller gift box when the body should feel more vertical than square.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the same bow and ribbon structure but widens the present into a square box.

items.depicts_observation: Three node branch graph with one left stem and one right split line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a three node branch diagram with one stem splitting to the right.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two node branch when only one curve should connect the bottom node to the top node.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows three circular nodes connected by one left stem and one right branching line.

items.depicts_observation: Two node branch graph with one left stem and one right curve
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simpler two node branch diagram with one curved connection.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the three node branch when a third node should appear at the upper left.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the branch graph to two nodes linked by one curved line and one left stem.

items.depicts_observation: Three node merge graph with one left stem and one right joining line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a three node merge diagram where one branch joins into the right node.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two node merge when the upper node should not split into a third point.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps three nodes but curves the right line inward to suggest a merge into one path.

items.depicts_observation: Two node merge graph with one left stem and one right downward curve
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a compact merge mark made from two nodes and one downward joining curve.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the three node merge when a lower left node should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot pares the merge graph down to two nodes with one curved line dropping toward the lower right.
